messages.en:
{07 1c 00}Thanks to you, I don't just
think fossils are a bunch
of dumb old bones.
{07 00 00}In fact, they're kinda cool.
And you were so selfless
about helping me, too.
{07 16 00}You're a good kid.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 11 00}We've really got to do
something about that!{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 00 00}Anyway{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}. I think I'm over
the whole fossil obsession
for a while.
But I want you to keep the
dream alive.{01 00 00 05 00} You're not bad
at finding 'em.
{07 15 00}Oh, and keep helping fossil
hunters in need{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 14 00}Got that, kid? {01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 1c 00}Tänu sulle ei pea ma
fossiile enam lihtsalt
rumalateks kontideks.
{07 00 00}Tegelikult on nad päris
lahedad. Ja sa aitasid mind
nii omakasupüüdmatult.
{07 16 00}Sa oled hea laps.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 11 00}Sellega peaks küll
midagi ette võtma!{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 00 00}Igatahes{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}. Ma olen
fossiilihullusest
mõneks ajaks üle.
Aga tahan, et sina hoiaksid
unistust elus.{01 00 00 05 00} Sa pole nende
leidmises halb.
{07 15 00}Ja aita edasi hädas
fossiilijahtijaid{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 14 00}Said aru, poiss? {01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Thanks for
helping me out with all this
fossil drama.
I know it's not like me, but
I really do appreciate it.
Imagine that, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 19 00}I think I'm done with the
whole fossil thing for a
while.
{07 00 00}But you should get out
there and find someone
else who needs your help!
{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 14 00}Oh yeah... {07 17 00}Uhhh...{01 00 00 05 00}
Thanks, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
